description: Use this when the user wants to see which bodyweight exercises Upfit can run. Returns the enabled exercises with Upfit's own difficulty rating (1 easiest to 9 hardest) and, where Upfit documents it, how you stand to the phone (facing it, side-on to it, or on the floor). Optional difficulty filters.

max_difficulty.description: Only exercises at or below this difficulty.

min_difficulty.description: Only exercises at or above this difficulty.

name: list_exercises
title: List Upfit exercises
